header.running_head: The fervour that Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) had to Spend in the Path of Allaah

When they distributed it amongst themselves, only five sevenths of the dues were settled. They then said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Sell him (as a slave) to settle the debts." Rasulullaah ﷺ refused saying, "Leave him alone. You cannot lodge any claims against him now." Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) then went to live with the Banu Salama tribe where someone said to him, "O Abu Abdur Rahmaan! Why do you not ask Rasulullaah ﷺ for something now that you have become a pauper." Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) however refused to ask from Rasulullaah ﷺ and stayed there a few days more until Rasulullaah ﷺ sent for him. Rasulullaah ﷺ dispatched him to Yemen to act as governor and said to him, "Perhaps Allaah shall redeem your losses and pay off your debt for you." Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) then proceeded to Yemen where he stayed until the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ. It was in the year that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) appointed Hadhrat Umar (RA) as the Ameer of Hajj that Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) also happened to be in Makkah (for Hajj). Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) therefore met on the 8th of Dhul Hijjah and they both embraced each other and consoled each other about the loss of Rasulullaah ﷺ. As they then sat down on the ground and started talking, Hadhrat Umar (RA) noticed that Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) had several slaves.[^1] The rest of the narration is the same as the one reported by Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) (which will be quoted hereunder).
The Narration of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) Concerning the Generosity of Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) reports that after the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ, the people appointed Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) as his successor. Rasulullaah ﷺ had appointed Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) as governor of Yemen and it was in the year that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) had appointed Hadhrat Umar (RA) as the Ameer of Hajj that Hadhrat Umar (RA) met Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) in Makkah. Noticing several slaves with Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Who are these people?" Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) replied, "The people of Yemen gave these as a gift to me while the others are for Abu Bakr (RA)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "I think that you should rather give them all to Abu Bakr (RA)." When the two men met again the following day, Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) said, "O Ibn Khattaab! When you saw me last night I was heading for the fire of Jahannam, but you grabbed hold of my waist (to save me by advising me to give all the slaves to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)).
